description: This file defines the ManufacturerService interface, which declares methods for managing Manufacturer entities such as listing, saving, updating, deleting, and handling manufacturer descriptions within the sales manager system. It also includes methods for retrieving manufacturers associated with specific stores, categories, and product attachments.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of manufacturers associated with a specific merchant store and language, throwing a ServiceException if an error occurs.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of manufacturers associated with a specific merchant store, without specifying language, throwing a ServiceException if an error occurs.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new manufacturer or updates an existing one.

methods.name: addManufacturerDescription
methods.description: Associates a ManufacturerDescription with a Manufacturer.

methods.name: getCountManufAttachedProducts
methods.description: Returns the number of products attached to a given manufacturer.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the specified manufacturer from the system.

methods.name: listByProductsByCategoriesId
methods.description: Lists manufacturers associated with products from specified categories within a store, filtered by language.
